SGP4XP.description: Simplified General Perturbation Model 4 eXtended Perturbations (SGP4-XP), as published in the 2022 astrodynamics conference literature.

SDNAP.description: SDN Advanced Propagator (SDN-AP): SDN's own semi-analytic mean-equinoctial theory with open-DCA drag, Starlink drag-makeup thrust and along-track terms. Its sets are osculating or mean about the center named in CENTER_NAME (Earth, Moon, Sun or a planet); see $OMM.
